article.headline: Sterling Young scores 22 to help Florida A&M beat Prairie View A&M 78-67
article.description: — Sterling Young had 22 points in Florida A&M's 78-67 victory over Prairie View A&M on Monday night.
article.linkText: Sterling Young scores 22 to help Florida A&M beat Prairie View A&M 78-67
article.story: PRAIRIE VIEW, Texas -- — Sterling Young had 22 points in Florida A&M's 78-67 victory over Prairie View A&M on Monday night. Young added seven rebounds and six assists for the Rattlers (10-12, 7-4 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Jordan Chatman totaled 17 points and eight rebounds. Milton Matthews had 15 points on 5-for-8 shooting from 3-point range. He missed all five of his two-point tries. Braelon Bush finished with 22 points and five assists to lead the Panthers (4-20, 3-8), who have lost seven in a row. Tanahj Pettway added 14 points and two steals. Elijah Terry added eight points and eight rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
